description: Forward a message from one channel into another, the way the Discord client's forward does: the original travels along as a quoted snapshot. Works across channels in the server. An optional note is posted as its own message just before the forward, since Discord does not allow text on the forward itself.

channel.description: Channel to forward the message into (name or ID).

content.description: Optional note, posted as a separate message just before the forward.

from_channel.description: Channel the message is currently in (name or ID).

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

message_id.description: ID of the message to forward.

name: forward_message
title: Forward message
